title: WOLFKM-8ii impl: RESET state machine + GEN_IV provider callback
description: Implement decisions from WOLFKM-8ii: (a) Option A: add iv_set tracking; after RESET, write() returns -EINVAL if ops->set_iv is non-NULL but iv_set is false. (b) Option A: add gen_iv callback to algo_ops; wolfssl providers use wc_RNG_GenerateBlock, kcapi falls back to get_random_bytes. (c) Option B: no framework change for GCM nonce length.
